name: maroto-component-overflow-and-continuation-6b28
instr:
Maroto cannot paginate content taller than the remaining body area while keeping layout measurements and physical PDF geometry consistent. Implement bounded component and row overflow so splittable content continues in order, indivisible content moves intact, and documents that already fit retain their observable output.

Every `core.Component`, including text, `FileImage`, `BytesImage`, barcode, `MatrixCode`, `QrCode`, signature, checkbox, and line components, must report a deterministic complete, continued, or deferred outcome without consuming its source. Nonpositive or nonfinite available height must return `core.ErrInvalidAvailableHeight` with text exactly `invalid available height`, without changing later measurement, rendering, or negotiation.

Split text only at provider-measured line boundaries, preserving content, order, properties, margins, and font behavior exactly once. Each image and scan-oriented code component must derive source-specific geometry independently, preserve declared or provider-derived proportions, scale uniformly into positive available space, render once through its matching provider operation, and never split encoded content. Signatures keep text and line atomic. Checkbox and line components retain fixed-height fitting behavior. Dimension lookup failure retains existing component height behavior without loops or phantom rendering.
